svg.aria-label: Flow versus open space. Left: in an open-fracture network the high-flow channel is also the largest open space, so flow share equals space share and per-fracture points sit on the 1:1 line. Right: in a mineral-filled network mid-dissolution the open space is upstream near the inlet while the flow is forced through still-filled fractures downstream, so flow share differs from space share and points fall above (filled) and below (open) the 1:1 line.
svg.text: wide aperture = most flow = most open space
so a channel in flow is also a channel in pore space
flow is set by the filled fractures downstream: PRpore falls, PRV holds
